component.notes:
Lyrion + Sonos soundbar. One component for a Sonos soundbar driven through Lyrion Music Server + the UPnP/DLNA Bridge plugin + the Savant Sonos Bridge Lyrion plugin.
Setup: - IP address = Lyrion server, port 9000. MAC address = the Lyrion player ID of the Sonos (e.g. bb:bb:12:34:56:01, from Lyrion > Settings > Player > Basic Settings). - Wire the TV's HDMI ARC/eARC to "HDMI eARC" and "SPEAKERS" to the zone's speakers. - Multi-room: SONOS GROUP OUT -> Sonos-Matrix input N, Sonos-Matrix output N -> SONOS GROUP IN (same N for this room on both sides; enter this room's player ID as Room N on the matrix). - Music service: Lyrion (Squeezebox browse incl. Spotify via Spotty). TV service: TV (eARC) input.
Feedback (System Monitor > state search "SonosSource"): SonosSource = TV | LYRION | GROUP | OTHER | IDLE (polled every 3 s; use for triggers) SonosTransportState, LyrionPower, CurrentVolume, CurrentMuteStatus When the soundbar switches to TV on its own, the Lyrion plugin powers the Lyrion player off. ====================== Change Log ================== Version: 1.4 Change: Sonos Group in/out for the Lyrion Sonos-Matrix (multi-room grouping); SonosSource GROUP. Version: 1.3 Change: Single logical component - TV (eARC) input moved into Media_server so Blueprint builds one music service. Version: 1.2 Change: Sonos status parsed before the catch-all Squeezebox Status message (it was overwriting now-playing); interface framing restored to stock. Version: 1.1 Change: Plugin URLs moved under plugins/SavantSonos/. Version: 1.0 Change: Initial release (Squeezebox Player-SM base + Sonos TV input, volume and source feedback).
